epics.title: EP-1: Tenancy & access foundations
epics.body:
**Goal:** every other epic depends on a correctly isolated, authenticated tenant shell. Nothing in Phase 1 can start safely until this exists.

PRD reference: §5 Multi-tenancy, §7.1 Authentication and access.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: Tenant-scoped data access middleware
stories.body:
All query paths are tenant-scoped by middleware, not developer discipline; row-level security in the database as second line of defence.

PRD ref: `TEN-1`. Epic: EP-1.

stories.title: Cross-tenant isolation guarantee
stories.body:
No cross-tenant join possible in application code; platform analytics reads only a metadata-only projection (counts/timestamps, no names/notes).

PRD ref: `TEN-2`. Epic: EP-1.

stories.title: Per-tenant encryption for free text
stories.body:
Engagement notes and escalation descriptions encrypted at rest with per-tenant keys; key destruction implements contractual deletion.

PRD ref: `TEN-3`. Epic: EP-1.

stories.title: Dedicated-instance deployment path
stories.body:
Same codebase, separate DB/key store, deployable for enterprise tenants.

**Blocked on open question:** does Unilever require dedicated instance + data residency region (PRD §11.4)? Must be answered before this is built, not just designed.

PRD ref: `TEN-4`. Epic: EP-1.

stories.title: Enterprise SSO sign-in
stories.body:
SAML 2.0 and OIDC; email-domain routing resolves tenant.

PRD ref: `AUTH-1`. Epic: EP-1.

stories.title: Role/function/reporting-line resolution from IdP
stories.body:
Tenant-configurable precedence between IdP claims and SET's own user record.

**Depends on open question:** authoritative org-hierarchy source — HRIS, Entra ID groups, or manual (PRD §11.4).

PRD ref: `AUTH-2`. Epic: EP-1.

stories.title: Demo/sandbox mode
stories.body:
Pre-seeded personas, watermarked, structurally incapable of holding production data.

PRD ref: `AUTH-3`. Epic: EP-1.

stories.title: Configurable session timeout
stories.body:
Per-tenant, default 12h mobile / 8h desktop.

PRD ref: `AUTH-4`. Epic: EP-1.

stories.title: Tenant Admin impersonation ("view as")
stories.body:
Read-only, banner-flagged, writes to audit log.

PRD ref: `AUTH-5`. Epic: EP-1.

stories.title: RBAC permission matrix
stories.body:
Role model decoupled from job title, configurable per tenant; enforce Field / Function Lead / Leadership / Admin permission boundaries.

PRD ref: §4.1. Epic: EP-1.

stories.title: Escalation visibility rule
stories.body:
Escalation raised in a function is visible to that Function Lead *and* Leadership simultaneously — does not queue behind the Head.

PRD ref: §4.1 note. Epic: EP-1.

stories.title: Audit log skeleton
stories.body:
Foundational event log (auth, permission changes) that EP-8's full audit log (`GOV-4`) extends.

Epic: EP-1.

epics.title: EP-2: Stakeholder registry
epics.body:
**Goal:** a clean, deduplicated, permissioned directory of stakeholder organizations — the spine everything else hangs off.

PRD reference: §7.2 Stakeholder registry.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: Core stakeholder record
stories.body:
Name, type, function, tier, assigned owner, status (active/dormant/archived), current sentiment, risk flag, description.

PRD ref: `REG-1`. Epic: EP-2.

stories.title: Tenant-configurable tiers & cadence
stories.body:
Default 3-tier model with cadence (Tier 1 monthly, Tier 2 quarterly, Tier 3 as-needed) and escalation-routing implications; tier count/definitions editable per tenant.

PRD ref: `REG-2`. Epic: EP-2.

stories.title: Tier change approval workflow
stories.body:
Leadership/Admin approval required, audit-logged.

PRD ref: `REG-2`. Epic: EP-2.

stories.title: Fuzzy-match dedupe warning at creation
stories.body:
Shows possible existing matches before a new stakeholder is created.

PRD ref: `REG-3`. Epic: EP-2.

stories.title: Alias field
stories.body:
Every stakeholder record supports aliases (e.g. "NAFDAC" / "N.A.F.D.A.C.").

PRD ref: `REG-3`. Epic: EP-2.

stories.title: Admin merge tool
stories.body:
Merges duplicate records while preserving both records' engagement history.

PRD ref: `REG-3`. Epic: EP-2.

stories.title: Request-a-stakeholder workflow
stories.body:
Field user submits request (name, type, why, proposed function) → routes to Function Lead/Admin with dedupe candidates shown to approver; 2-working-day SLA target; requester notified; auto-assigned to requester on approval unless reassigned.

PRD ref: `REG-4`. Epic: EP-2.

stories.title: Directory search & filter
stories.body:
By function, type, tier, sentiment, risk flag, owner, last-engagement recency; Leadership's "Activity by function" table filters Directory on click.

PRD ref: `REG-5`. Epic: EP-2.

stories.title: Field-user reduced directory view
stories.body:
Field users see existence + owner, not engagement notes.

**Depends on open question:** should Heads get read-only cross-function Directory visibility (PRD §11.4)?

PRD ref: `REG-5`. Epic: EP-2.

stories.title: Coverage-gap ("going cold") detection
stories.body:
Flags any stakeholder with no engagement logged within its tier's expected cadence, surfaced on owner's and Head's dashboards.

PRD ref: `REG-6`. Epic: EP-2.

epics.title: EP-3: Engagement logging (critical path)
epics.body:
**Goal:** capture a meeting in under 60 seconds. This is the epic the product lives or dies on — treat the 60s figure as a hard performance budget for every story below, not an aspiration.

PRD reference: §7.3 Engagement logging.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: One-tap log entry
stories.body:
Reachable from field user's home screen at all times.

PRD ref: `ENG-1`. Epic: EP-3.

stories.title: Minimum viable log
stories.body:
Stakeholder, date, channel, sentiment, one-line summary — five fields, everything else optional.

PRD ref: `ENG-2`. Epic: EP-3.

stories.title: Aggressive smart defaults
stories.body:
Date=today; stakeholder=most-recently-engaged or nearest-by-geolocation if enabled; channel=last used; logger=current user.

PRD ref: `ENG-3`. Epic: EP-3.

stories.title: Tap-target sentiment capture
stories.body:
Three large tap targets on tenant's sentiment scale, not a dropdown.

PRD ref: `ENG-4`. Epic: EP-3.

stories.title: Voice-to-text on summary field
stories.body:
A field officer in a car park will speak but not type.

PRD ref: `ENG-5`. Epic: EP-3.

stories.title: Progressive disclosure of optional fields
stories.body:
Attendees (internal and external), topics/tags, attachments, next-step commitment, escalate-this toggle.

PRD ref: `ENG-6`. Epic: EP-3.

stories.title: Offline-first capture
stories.body:
Draft persists locally, syncs on reconnect, clear pending state. Non-negotiable — treat as launch blocker for field rollout, not a nice-to-have.

PRD ref: `ENG-7`. Epic: EP-3.

stories.title: Draft auto-save
stories.body:
An interrupted log is never lost.

PRD ref: `ENG-8`. Epic: EP-3.

stories.title: Edit window & append-only correction history
stories.body:
Logger can edit own engagement for 24h; after that, edits are visible append-only corrections (evidentiary integrity).

PRD ref: `ENG-9`. Epic: EP-3.

stories.title: Inline commitment creation
stories.body:
Created from engagement, inherits stakeholder, owner defaults to logger, due-date picker with common relative options.

PRD ref: `ENG-10`. Epic: EP-3.

stories.title: Log-on-behalf-of with notification
stories.body:
Head+ can log an engagement on a stakeholder they don't own; owner is notified. Prevents silent parallel engagement.

PRD ref: `ENG-11`. Epic: EP-3.

epics.title: EP-4: Sentiment, risk & trend
epics.body:
**Goal:** turn individually-logged engagements into portfolio-level, explainable risk visibility for leadership.

PRD reference: §7.4 Sentiment, risk and trend.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: Per-engagement sentiment assertion
stories.body:
Stakeholder's current sentiment = sentiment of most recent engagement.

**Depends on open question:** single-axis vs two-axis sentiment model (PRD §11.4) — recommend shipping single-axis, testing in pilot.

PRD ref: `RISK-1`. Epic: EP-4.

stories.title: Portfolio sentiment trend chart
stories.body:
Monthly aggregate with Improving/Stable/Declining label; in-product info affordance documenting the formula. Default weighting: tier-weighted mean, Tier 1×3, Tier 2×2, Tier 3×1.

PRD ref: `RISK-2`. Epic: EP-4.

stories.title: Current sentiment mix panel
stories.body:
Percentage split across sentiment values for the visible (role-scoped) portfolio.

PRD ref: `RISK-3`. Epic: EP-4.

stories.title: High-risk flag engine
stories.body:
Tenant-configurable rules; defaults = Resistant sentiment on Tier 1/2, sentiment declined 2 steps in 60 days, open escalation exists, overdue High-priority commitment exists, Tier 1 with no engagement in 60 days.

PRD ref: `RISK-4`. Epic: EP-4.

stories.title: Explainable flags
stories.body:
Hover/tap a risk indicator states which rule fired — no black-box scoring.

PRD ref: `RISK-5`. Epic: EP-4.

stories.title: Trend baseline guard
stories.body:
Requires ≥3 months history before showing a trend; shows an honest "building baseline" state before that.

PRD ref: `RISK-6`. Epic: EP-4.

epics.title: EP-5: Commitments
epics.body:
**Goal:** track promises in both directions — what the company owes the stakeholder, and what the stakeholder owes the company.

PRD reference: §7.5 Commitments.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: Commitment record
stories.body:
Stakeholder, description, internal owner, due date, priority, state (open/done/dropped with reason on drop).

PRD ref: `COM-1`. Epic: EP-5.

stories.title: Field-user "my open commitments" view
stories.body:
Own open commitments only, sorted by due date, on home screen.

PRD ref: `COM-2`. Epic: EP-5.

stories.title: Head/Leadership commitments-in-scope view
stories.body:
All commitments in scope with owner attribution + "due this week" count.

PRD ref: `COM-3`. Epic: EP-5.

stories.title: Commitment reminders
stories.body:
T-3 days and due-date, via tenant-configured channel (email + in-app minimum for v1).

PRD ref: `COM-4`. Epic: EP-5.

stories.title: Overdue escalation visibility
stories.body:
Escalates to Head at +3 days, to Leadership at +10 days on Tier 1 stakeholders.

PRD ref: `COM-5`. Epic: EP-5.

stories.title: Bidirectional commitments
stories.body:
Commitments made *by* the stakeholder to the company, distinguished by direction.

PRD ref: `COM-6`. Epic: EP-5.

epics.title: EP-6: Escalations
epics.body:
**Goal:** surface problems immediately to the people who can act, without a game of telephone.

PRD reference: §7.6 Escalations.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: Raise escalation
stories.body:
From an engagement or directly from a stakeholder, any user.

PRD ref: `ESC-1`. Epic: EP-6.

stories.title: Escalation record
stories.body:
Reason, severity, requested intervention, raised-by, timestamp.

PRD ref: `ESC-2`. Epic: EP-6.

stories.title: Escalation board
stories.body:
Ordered by severity then tier; shows stakeholder, tier badge, one-line reason, risk and sentiment chips.

PRD ref: `ESC-3`. Epic: EP-6.

stories.title: Immediate dual visibility + nav badge counts
stories.body:
Visible to relevant Function Lead and Leadership simultaneously.

PRD ref: `ESC-4`. Epic: EP-6.

stories.title: Resolution workflow
stories.body:
Requires resolution note, closes with timestamped record; history retained on the stakeholder permanently.

PRD ref: `ESC-5`. Epic: EP-6.

stories.title: Ageing indicator
stories.body:
Escalations open >7 days visually distinguished.

PRD ref: `ESC-6`. Epic: EP-6.

epics.title: EP-7: Role dashboards
epics.body:
**Goal:** each role sees exactly what it needs and nothing else — this is a functional requirement, not visual polish.

PRD reference: §7.7 Role dashboards.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: Field home
stories.body:
Greeting, date, primary Log Engagement CTA, my-stakeholder count, request-a-stakeholder shortcut, my open commitments. Nothing else — answers exactly one question.

PRD ref: §7.7. Epic: EP-7.

stories.title: Function Lead home
stories.body:
Function badge, escalation count in greeting, four KPI tiles (high risk / open escalations / commitments due this week / supportive %), portfolio sentiment trend + mix, team panel (direct reports with stakeholder counts + open escalations), escalation board, upcoming commitments with owners, recent Tier 1 activity feed.

**Depends on open question:** should Heads get cross-function read access (PRD §11.4)?

PRD ref: §7.7. Epic: EP-7.

stories.title: Leadership home
stories.body:
As Function Lead, org-wide; function badge replaced by Activity-by-function table (function, stakeholder count, high-risk count, escalation count, click-to-filter Directory); team panel replaced by cross-function rollup.

PRD ref: §7.7. Epic: EP-7.

stories.title: Admin home
stories.body:
Leadership view + Governance access.

PRD ref: §7.7. Epic: EP-7.

stories.title: Activity feed
stories.body:
Chronological cross-portfolio stream, badge-counted, role-scoped; Recent Tier 1 activity is a filtered view of the same stream.

PRD ref: §7.7. Epic: EP-7.

stories.title: Progressive navigation by role
stories.body:
Field user sees 3 nav items, admin sees 5 — deliberately near-empty for field, not a placeholder state.

PRD ref: §6.1. Epic: EP-7.

epics.title: EP-8: Governance & admin
epics.body:
**Goal:** give admins the tools to keep the registry clean and the system accountable, without engineering involvement.

PRD reference: §7.8 Governance (Admin).

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: User management
stories.body:
Invite, deactivate, role assignment, function assignment, reporting-line maintenance.

PRD ref: `GOV-1`. Epic: EP-8.

stories.title: Taxonomy management
stories.body:
Functions, stakeholder types, tier definitions/cadences, sentiment labels, commitment priorities, risk-rule thresholds — all tenant-editable.

PRD ref: `GOV-2`. Epic: EP-8.

stories.title: Registry hygiene queue
stories.body:
Pending stakeholder requests, duplicate candidates, unassigned stakeholders, stakeholders with deactivated owners, records going cold.

PRD ref: `GOV-3`. Epic: EP-8.

stories.title: Immutable audit log
stories.body:
Covers auth, permission changes, tier changes, engagement creation/edits, escalation state changes, merges, exports, impersonation sessions; exportable; retention configurable, default 7 years.

PRD ref: `GOV-4`. Epic: EP-8.

stories.title: Scoped export
stories.body:
CSV/XLSX of stakeholders, engagements, commitments, escalations, scoped to requester's permissions, every export audit-logged.

PRD ref: `GOV-5`. Epic: EP-8.

stories.title: Offboarding reassignment queue
stories.body:
Deactivated user's stakeholders enter a mandatory reassignment queue — cannot be orphaned. This is the mechanism behind the core "relationship equity doesn't walk out the door" promise.

PRD ref: `GOV-6`. Epic: EP-8.

epics.title: EP-9: Notifications
epics.body:
**Goal:** the right nudge, on the right channel, without becoming noise.

PRD reference: §7.9 Notifications.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: Per-user notification toggles
stories.body:
All notification types individually toggleable per user.

PRD ref: §7.9. Epic: EP-9.

stories.title: Admin-only escalation notification control
stories.body:
Escalation notifications toggleable only by Admin (can't be silenced by an individual).

PRD ref: §7.9. Epic: EP-9.

stories.title: Commitment reminders (notification delivery)
stories.body:
T-3 and due-date reminders via tenant's configured channel. Shared with EP-5 (COM-4) — this story covers the notification-delivery side.

PRD ref: `COM-4`. Epic: EP-9.

stories.title: Owner notification on log-on-behalf-of
stories.body:
Shared with EP-3 (ENG-11) — this story covers the notification-delivery side.

PRD ref: `ENG-11`. Epic: EP-9.

stories.title: v1.1 candidate channels: Teams & WhatsApp Business
stories.body:
Flag as fast-follow given field-user reality in this market, not v1 scope.

PRD ref: `COM-4`. Epic: EP-9.

epics.title: EP-10: Mobile & offline
epics.body:
**Goal:** the field experience has to work on a phone, on 3G, in a car park.

PRD reference: §7.10 Mobile.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: Responsive web + installable PWA
stories.body:
v1 delivery mechanism, offline capture.

PRD ref: `MOB-1`. Epic: EP-10.

stories.title: Mobile-first field / desktop-first leadership
stories.body:
Explicit design direction split by role.

PRD ref: `MOB-2`. Epic: EP-10.

stories.title: Offline coverage for core field actions
stories.body:
Viewing my stakeholders, viewing my commitments, creating an engagement, creating a commitment — all work offline; sync on reconnect with conflict surfacing.

PRD ref: `MOB-3`. Epic: EP-10.

stories.title: 3G performance budget
stories.body:
Interactive within 3s, log screen within 1s of tap.

PRD ref: `MOB-4`. Epic: EP-10.

stories.title: Native app decision gate
stories.body:
v2 decision, contingent on PWA offline reliability and push notifications proving sufficient in the Unilever pilot — not a story to build yet, a decision checkpoint.

PRD ref: `MOB-5`. Epic: EP-10.

epics.title: EP-11: Non-functional / platform quality
epics.body:
**Goal:** the operational guarantees that make this deployable to an enterprise tenant. Cross-cutting — apply to every epic above rather than shipping as a separate feature.

PRD reference: §8 Non-functional requirements.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: Performance budgets
stories.body:
p95 dashboard <2s broadband / <4s on 3G; engagement submit acknowledged <500ms via optimistic UI + background sync.

PRD ref: §8. Epic: EP-11.

stories.title: Availability targets
stories.body:
99.5% monthly uptime v1, 99.9% once a second enterprise tenant is live; planned maintenance windows outside 06:00–20:00 tenant-local.

PRD ref: §8. Epic: EP-11.

stories.title: Scale design targets
stories.body:
500 tenants, 50,000 users, 5,000 stakeholders and 100,000 engagements per tenant — single well-indexed relational DB, explicitly do not over-engineer beyond this.

PRD ref: §8. Epic: EP-11.

stories.title: Security baseline
stories.body:
TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest with per-tenant keys for free text (ties to `TEN-3`), encrypted tested backups, RPO 1h / RTO 4h, annual pentest, SOC 2 Type II on roadmap.

PRD ref: §8. Epic: EP-11.

stories.title: Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
stories.body:
Specifically fix sentiment/risk color-only encoding (needs shape/label reinforcement) and add an accessible tabular alternative to the sentiment trend bar chart.

PRD ref: §8. Epic: EP-11.

stories.title: Localization scaffolding
stories.body:
Full i18n scaffolding from day one even though v1 ships en-GB only; date/number/timezone formatting per tenant locale.

PRD ref: §8. Epic: EP-11.

stories.title: Browser/OS support matrix
stories.body:
Evergreen Chrome/Edge/Safari/Firefox; iOS 16+ and Android 10+ mobile browsers.

PRD ref: §8. Epic: EP-11.

epics.title: EP-12: Data protection & anti-bribery compliance
epics.body:
**Goal:** the product's subject matter — tracking engagement with regulators and officials in a high-risk jurisdiction — makes this epic load-bearing, not a checkbox. Start in Phase 0/1, not bolted on later.

PRD reference: §11.2 Data protection, §11.3 Anti-bribery and corruption.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: Design to NDPA + GDPR-grade standard
stories.body:
Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 applies to Unilever Nigeria; design to the stricter GDPR standard given likely global requirement.

PRD ref: `DP-1`. Epic: EP-12.

stories.title: Contact retention schedule
stories.body:
Documented lawful basis + retention (recommend 24 months post-last-engagement for individuals; organization-level history retained longer).

PRD ref: `DP-2`. Epic: EP-12.

stories.title: Subject access & erasure workflow
stories.body:
Locate and redact personal data about a named individual without destroying organizational engagement history.

PRD ref: `DP-3`. Epic: EP-12.

stories.title: Notes-discipline guidance
stories.body:
In-field guidance text + mandatory training element ("record what was discussed and agreed; avoid speculation about individuals").

PRD ref: `DP-4`. Epic: EP-12.

stories.title: Special-category data guard
stories.body:
No storage of health/religion/political/ethnicity data on contacts; consider automated warning on entry of likely special-category terms.

PRD ref: `DP-5`. Epic: EP-12.

stories.title: No free-text bribery path
stories.body:
Never provide a free-text field where recording an improper payment is the path of least resistance; if gifts/hospitality are tracked, build a structured register with value thresholds and approval routing, or omit entirely and link to tenant's existing compliance system — no half-version.

PRD ref: `ABC-1`. Epic: EP-12.

stories.title: Legal & Compliance pilot involvement
stories.body:
Process/stakeholder requirement — Legal & Compliance function lead included in rollout design, not just as a recipient.

PRD ref: `ABC-2`. Epic: EP-12.

stories.title: Compliance-concern escalation category
stories.body:
Escalation reason routes directly to Legal, bypassing normal function hierarchy.

PRD ref: `ABC-3`. Epic: EP-12.

stories.title: Tamper-evident audit trail
stories.body:
Audit log sufficient to demonstrate notes were not retrospectively altered (ties to `GOV-4`) — the property that gives the record evidentiary weight.

PRD ref: `ABC-4`. Epic: EP-12.

epics.title: EP-13: Multi-tenant self-serve onboarding
epics.body:
**Goal:** a second tenant can be onboarded without engineering involvement — this is what makes the product a platform rather than a bespoke Unilever build.

PRD reference: §5.3 Tenant onboarding.

Stories are tracked as sub-issues of this epic.

stories.title: Platform admin tenant creation
stories.body:
Create tenant, set plan and residency, issue tenant-admin invite.

PRD ref: §5.3. Epic: EP-13.

stories.title: Guided tenant admin setup
stories.body:
Branding, SSO connection, functions, stakeholder types, tier definitions, sentiment labels.

PRD ref: §5.3. Epic: EP-13.

stories.title: Bulk import tooling
stories.body:
CSV/SCIM user import; CSV stakeholder import with dedupe preview (reuses `REG-3` dedupe logic).

PRD ref: §5.3. Epic: EP-13.

stories.title: Phased function activation
stories.body:
Pilot function activated first, remaining functions enabled in sequence.

PRD ref: §5.3. Epic: EP-13.

stories.title: Onboarding SLA target: 10 working days
stories.body:
10 working days from contract to first live engagement logged — treat as the acceptance metric for this whole epic.

PRD ref: §5.3. Epic: EP-13.

epics.title: EP-14: Phase 4 candidates (parking lot)
epics.body:
**Goal:** explicitly deferred per PRD §10, contingent on pilot evidence. Do not pull into earlier phases without a deliberate re-prioritization decision.

PRD reference: §10 Release plan, Phase 4.

Sub-issues below are unscheduled candidates, not committed scope.

stories.title: NLP-assisted sentiment suggestion from engagement notes
stories.body:
Deferred candidate. Not in v1 scope — v1 sentiment is human-asserted only (see PRD §3.2 non-goals).

Epic: EP-14.

stories.title: Teams and WhatsApp Business logging channels
stories.body:
Deferred candidate beyond the v1.1 reminder-channel fast-follow in EP-9.

Epic: EP-14.

stories.title: Calendar integration to prompt logging after external meetings
stories.body:
Deferred candidate.

Epic: EP-14.

stories.title: Stakeholder influence-network mapping
stories.body:
Deferred candidate.

Epic: EP-14.

stories.title: Board-pack report generation
stories.body:
Deferred candidate.

Epic: EP-14.

stories.title: Native mobile apps
stories.body:
Deferred candidate — gated on the EP10-S5 PWA decision checkpoint.

Epic: EP-14.

stories.title: Gifts-and-hospitality register
stories.body:
Deferred candidate — only build as the structured register described in `ABC-1`; never as a free-text field.

Epic: EP-14.
